[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Hiram was born in 1800. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1982|Wilson Glasgow]] and [[McCracken-3711|Mary McCracken]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1982]] is assessed at 98% (proved). Mary Glasgow’s 1837 will, identifying her as Wilson’s widow, explicitly calls Hiram her son and makes him trustee for Mariah. Wilson’s real-estate packet lists Hiram among the same seven-child family, and the maintained account connects his 1847 estate.

The combined widow’s will and Wilson-family estate index strongly support Wilson’s paternity; the original packet is still needed for its exact kin wording.

Next useful test: Inspect Wilson’s real-estate packet 1-13 for Hiram’s explicit heir description.

Source basis already held: [https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247id_/http://www.lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Paper_WilsonGlasgowWife.html Newberry District, South Carolina, Will Book N, p. 1, will of Mary Glasgow, widow of Wilson Glasgow, dated 28 November 1837 and proved 22 October 1838; transcription (https://web.archive.org/web/20101124184247 id_/http://www.lifesweaving.com/Glasgow/Paper_WilsonGlasgowWife.html). The displayed recording date of July 1837 precedes execution and is evidently a transcription error.]; [https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/realestate.html Newberry County, South Carolina, real-estate packet 1-13, estate of Wilson Glasgow; index (https://genealogytrails.com/scar/newberry/realestate.html), entries for Wilson Glasgow and Mary, Robert, Ruth, Naomi, Matilda, Hiram, Almina and Maria.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
